theorems.name: Submission.constancy_mollifier_iteratedFDeriv_norm_le_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Eucl n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Eucl n → ℝ, Integrable g volume → ∀ x : Eucl n, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ q (convolution φ g (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x‖ ≤ C * ∫ y, |g y| ∂volume
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
